prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: flat background artwork for a macOS DMG installer, companion to Peta's approved Discord download header.
Input image 1 is the approved Peta download banner: use only its exact physical cream paper, warm off-white palette, matte die-cut cream-soda sticker and torn kraft-paper styling as reference. Create a NEW landscape 3:2 composition (ideally 1536x1024), perfectly flat top-down artwork, NOT a mockup, with NO typography or logos, NO icons or interface.
The entire top 82% of the image must be quiet, nearly uniform warm ivory paper with very fine subtle fibers. The center must be clean and empty for later installer icons.
At the bottom right only: a small simple pale green cream soda with vanilla ice cream and one red cherry, as a physical matte paper sticker with a clearly visible warm white die-cut border, slight paper thickness and subtle natural contact shadow. It occupies approximately x=80–97%, y=76–99% of the canvas, cropped a little at the bottom. It rests on a narrow piece of warm tan kraft paper torn diagonally across the bottom-right corner, confined below y=86%. Leave all the left side and the large center empty.
Match the existing gentle hand-painted sticker, with irregular sparse watercolor marks, unpolished and charming, not highly detailed. Avoid blue flowers, other motifs, excessive texture, 3D glass shine, bokeh, dramatic gradients, vignette, frames, text, logos, arrows, placeholders. Do not recreate any of the source text. The result is usable background artwork, not a screenshot.
status: design draft; not an approved replacement of existing assets
